verdict.rationale: Meltano ships a fully documented CLI (meltano add/init/config, etc.) that can be scripted, and MeltanoHub exposes a machine-readable plugin registry API, but explicit probes show no OpenAPI/REST API or llms.txt for the core product, meaning an AI agent cannot drive Meltano through a conventional public API beyond shelling out to the CLI. missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI or SDK-style public API, llms.txt or agent-facing API spec, independent confirmation of programmatic (non-CLI) control.
